biography.value:
Ethereal dragons drift through the misty border between worlds, watching the Material Plane like spectators at a play. They are curious and patient, trading secrets with travelers who wander the Deep Ethereal, and they fiercely hunt the creatures that prey on lost souls there.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .1d3BZlJD6CPIzNYc]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .HkzJxHOqwHIVqxNO]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .03aMNP8RYNORSK9O]]{claws}.

Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=JVPqy3RtqIFRYV7E]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=JVPqy3RtqIFRYV7E]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=JVPqy3RtqIFRYV7E]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=7KQh3aYt3BUh8v9K]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a beam of shimmering force in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=KtWUeNtrZww7T0Od]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=KtWUeNtrZww7T0Od]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=KtWUeNtrZww7T0Od]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.
As a bonus action, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically shifts from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa. It can't do so again until it finishes a short or long rest.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • Curtains of ethereal mist fill a 20-foot cube; the area is heavily obscured until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • One creature the dragon can see within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be pulled into the Ethereal Plane until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • The dragon and up to three creatures it can see within 60 feet each teleport up to 30 feet to unoccupied spaces they can see.
